fusions.name: One Gulp
fusions.desc: A snap that deals 16 damage, uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 50% more damage for each one, and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Death Roll
fusions.desc: Clamps and rolls for 30 damage, plus 5% of the target's maximum health if it is a boss or elite, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 4 damage a second for 5 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Basking Gorge
fusions.desc: Restores 20 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Lying in Wait
fusions.desc: When your stamina reaches full, you heal for 30% of all damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
